build_SoftDTW_module: build a pytorch module that computes soft DTW loss between two batches of time series sequences
run_SoftDTW_forward: run the SoftDTW forward pass to compute differentiable DTW distance between two sequence tensors on GPU
create_euclidean_dist_func: create a function that calculates the pairwise euclidean distance matrix between two batches of sequences

profile_SoftDTW_cpu_gpu: profile the SoftDTW module comparing CPU and GPU performance across different batch sizes and sequence lengths
